projectDescription: A lightweight C library for building simple GUI applications on Linux using the X11 windowing system.
keyFeatures: Minimal X11-backed window creation and management
UI element system: text, buttons, inputs, checkboxes, rects, and images
Software-rendered image canvas with palette-indexed colors
Built-in sprite drawing with RLE encoding
Event system: keyboard, mouse, and window close callbacks
C-compatible header for use from C and C++ projects
Shared library distributed as a single .so file
